title: Multivariate Axonal Simulator for Tractography Evaluation
text: master — Multivariate Axonal Simulator Tractography Evaluation — generates realistic white-matter bundles (fascicles) microstructural attributes evaluating diffusion-MRI tractography. implements functional-data-analysis generative design MASTER model: reference centerline pathway (flat central interaction segment smooth bending arms, assembled tangent-angle integration reparametrized curvilinear arc length) perturbed zero-mean functional random fields axons expressed B-spline basis exponentially autocorrelated Gaussian coefficients. master builds fiber package (S7 streamline / bundle / bundle_set classes) emits fiber::bundle objects ready interactive visualization rtists.

title: Multivariate Axonal Simulator for Tractography Evaluation
text: Generate single smooth centerline, populate bundle perturbed axons: Build pre-defined interaction configuration fiber::bundle_set
code: #| label: example library(master)  # A straight central segment with two smoothly bending arms cl <- generate_centerline(angle = 0.6, arm_length = 1,                           interaction_length = 2, n_points = 200) head(cl)          # N x 3 matrix, columns X, Y, Z  # A bundle of 20 axons coherently perturbed around that centerline b <- create_axons(cl, n_axons = 20, n_basis = 8, variance = 0.02,                   autocorrelation = 2, seed = 1) fiber::is_bundle(b)   # TRUE b@n_streamlines       # 20 #| label: scenario st <- simulate_scenario("crossing", n_axons = 10, seed = 1) fiber::is_bundle_set(st)   # TRUE st@n_bundles               # 2  # Visualize with rtists (if installed) # rtists::plot3d(st)  # Export to the master CSV layout for downstream tractography tools generate_csv(st, tempfile(fileext = ".csv"))

title: Multivariate Axonal Simulator for Tractography Evaluation
text: bundle grown reference centerline whose tangent angle ramps smoothly -angle +angle exactly flat central segment length interaction_length (see [generate_centerline()]). centerline reparametrized curvilinear arc length, axon drawn centerline plus smooth functional perturbation modelled B-spline expansion exponentially autocorrelated Gaussian coefficients (see [create_axons()]). Pre-assembled configurations — bending, fanning, merging, kissing, crossing — available [simulate_scenario()].

title: Generate a bundle of axons around a centreline — create_axons
text: centerline numeric N x 3 matrix (columns X, Y, Z) giving mean pathway; see generate_centerline(). n_axons Number streamlines (axons) bundle. n_basis Number B-spline coefficients per coordinate (smoothness perturbation). variance Coefficient variance sigma^2 controlling bundle diameter. autocorrelation Positive correlation rate > 0 (space independent perfectly coherent streamlines). radius Optional axonal radius (scalar length-N vector). seed Optional integer seed reproducibility draws.

title: Generate a bundle of axons around a centreline — create_axons
text: fiber::bundle n_axons streamlines.

title: Generate a bundle of axons around a centreline — create_axons
text: perturbation coordinate linear combination n_basis B-spline functions centreline abscissa zero-mean Gaussian coefficients carrying exponential autocorrelation. field zero-mean, sample mean bundle stays true centreline. axon carries per-point microstructure attributes @point_data: curvature, torsion unit tangent components dir_x, dir_y, dir_z, computed axon's geometry. radius scalar stored per-streamline; length-N vector stored per-point radius.

title: Generate a bundle of axons around a centreline — create_axons

what: Generate a smooth centerline with a flat interaction segment — generate_centerline
title: Generate a smooth centerline with a flat interaction segment — generate_centerline
text: Assembles single reference mean-pathway integrating tangent-angle field arc length. central interaction segment exactly straight interaction_length units; two equal arms bend smoothly (C1) angle (radians). result already parametrized curvilinear arc length discretized onto n_points equally spaced points (via fiber::reparametrize()).

title: Generate a smooth centerline with a flat interaction segment — generate_centerline
code: generate_centerline(   angle = 0.5,   arm_length = 1,   interaction_length = 2,   rotation = 0,   vertical_bend = 0,   n_points = 1000L )

title: Generate a smooth centerline with a flat interaction segment — generate_centerline
text: angle Bending angle (radians) reached arm. Bounded (-pi/2, pi/2). arm_length Length (output units) straight run bending arms lead flat central segment. Together interaction_length sets far arms extend. interaction_length Length flat central (straight) part centreline, units output points. rotation Rotation (radians) applied whole centreline vertical (Y) axis generation. Defaults 0. vertical_bend Optional bend angle (radians) applied xy-plane (towards z), centreline can tile truly 3-D fascicle. Defaults 0 (planar centreline). n_points Number equally spaced points grid (curvilinear arc length). Defaults 1000.

title: Generate a smooth centerline with a flat interaction segment — generate_centerline
text: n_points x 3 numeric matrix column names X, Y, Z giving arc-length-parametrized centreline.

title: Generate a smooth centerline with a flat interaction segment — generate_centerline
code: cl <- generate_centerline(angle = 0.6, arm_length = 1,                           interaction_length = 2, n_points = 200) colnames(cl) # c("X", "Y", "Z") #> [1] "X" "Y" "Z" nrow(cl)     # 200 #> [1] 200

code: simulate_scenario(   configuration = "bending",   n_axons = 30,   angle = 0.5,   arm_length = 1,   interaction_length = 2,   variance = 0.02,   autocorrelation = 2,   n_basis = 8,   n_points = 300L,   separation = 0.3,   seed = NULL )

title: Simulate a fascicle scenario as a fiber::bundle_set — simulate_scenario
text: configuration One "bending", "fanning", "merging", "kissing", "crossing". n_axons Number streamlines (per bundle two-bundle configurations, total "bending" "fanning"). angle Bending angle (radians), shared geometry parameter. arm_length Length bending arm, shared geometry parameter. interaction_length Flat interaction length, shared geometry parameter. variance Coefficient variance controlling bundle diameter. autocorrelation Correlation rate (space independent coherent streamlines). n_basis Number B-spline coefficients per coordinate. n_points Number points per centreline arc-length reparametrization. separation Separation mean pathways two-bundle configurations ("merging", "kissing", "crossing"). seed Optional integer seed full reproducibility.

title: Simulate a fascicle scenario as a fiber::bundle_set — simulate_scenario
text: fiber::bundle_set one (bending, fanning) two (merging, kissing, crossing) named bundles.

title: Simulate a fascicle scenario as a fiber::bundle_set — simulate_scenario
text: "bending": single bundle whose mean pathway bends (generate_centerline()). "fanning": single bundle diverges two branches fork; half axons follow one branch, half (axon splits). "merging": two bundles start apart run together. "kissing": two bundles meet, travel together, part. "crossing": two bundles whose mean pathways touch point continue; streamlines interlace without fusion.

title: Simulate a fascicle scenario as a fiber::bundle_set — simulate_scenario
code: st <- simulate_scenario("crossing", n_axons = 10, seed = 1) fiber::is_bundle_set(st)      # TRUE #> [1] TRUE st@n_bundles                  # 2 #> [1] 2
